decisions.reason: As a newly launched and only lightly promoted adjacent product, it still looks like a low-cost option worth keeping open for another year, though the limited visibility raises some risk of withdrawal if demand stays weak.

Its own product page and clear customer-value proposition suggest a more committed market test, so with uncertainty still high after launch the firm would likely continue rather than abandon it quickly.

A standalone page indicates deliberate commitment, and for an established manufacturer a specialized unit is an option worth preserving until more market feedback arrives, even if its higher commercialization costs create some exit risk.
